name: sharing a folder needs the owner's fresh confirmation: a share started without it shares nothing
description: ICLOUD-014 (sync-chaos share-links-and-revocation): CVE-2025-30448, another process could turn on sharing of an iCloud folder without authentication. Rules M1 and S14: a share is made only with the owner's fresh authentication; without it no share key is wrapped for anyone and the drive is unchanged.
pending: drive_share {device, path, recipient, fresh_auth (bool)} answering {shared} (AzDrive's share flow, success true either way); drive_check share_keys {device, path, count} (recipients the folder's key is wrapped for)
